## Before the class begins on 2025-09-02

If you have any questions before class begins, email Professor Love at `thomas dot love at case dot edu`.

## Once the Class Begins

If you’ve spent 15 minutes working on something and are stuck, don’t keep working on it. ASK FOR HELP. To get help in this course, you have three main options 

1. Ask a TA for help during their office hours, 
2. send an email to **431-help** at **case** dot **edu**, or
3. ask Dr. Love for help before or after class.

## TA Office Hours

Our [Shared Google Drive (431 Fall 2025 Dr Love and Students)](google.qmd) will display Zoom links for all TA office hours in a document called **TA office hours schedule and Zoom links**. No appointment is necessary. Please just drop in.

## Does Dr. Love hold Office Hours?

Professor Love holds “drop-in hours” for 10 minutes before and for 30 minutes after each class on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
